page.overview:
What is Fazbear Entertainment?

Fazbear Entertainment, LLC, formerly Inc. and abbreviated to FE, is the company that owns and runs the establishments (namely pizza and entertainment venues) that player characters are employed under in many of the baseline Five Nights at Freddy's games. The company was founded by Henry Emily and William Afton.

On the outside, they are a well-known and beloved children's brand, but on the inside, they are a negligent, lazy, and greedy corporation. They have knowledge of the dangers associated with their machines, but deliberately obscure this information and are responsible for many incidents over the years and also show very little concern if at all for their employees.

Not much is known about the company before the 80s.

It is presumed that the company was founded around this decade (though certain collectibles and characters dialogue suggest it might go back as far as the 1960s) and created Fredbear's Singin' Show followed by Fredbear's Family Diner.
